verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's CKS documentation confirms per-cluster VPC networking and Terraform-managed VPC resources, supporting private networking between instances, but there is no explicit documentation of exposing ports or serving applications (e.g., load balancers, ingress, public endpoints) from an instance. Missing for 10: explicit port-exposure/ingress or service-endpoint documentation, and confirmation that private networking works across instances beyond VPC provisioning claims.
